delivery_commit_identity: The additive commit introducing this receipt is V; its exact SHA is externally observable from the Git branch and final delivery response, avoiding a self-referential commit hash.
publication_scope: P contains every source/evidence/PDF/CI file in the ZIP; V adds the same ZIP as 30 Git blobs and transport records. Neither P nor V changes S source bytes. Publication-only commits skip duplicate CI; no successful workflow is claimed for a different source HEAD.

readback.verification: Every member read to EOF, with ZIP CRC, SHA256, Git blob, size, name and mode checks.

scientific_scope: Completed author revision and original-objective study with full negative evidence. This package does not imply Econometrica acceptance, universal neural superiority, closure of every historical scientific obligation, or completion of other independently frozen experiments.
virtual_flags_scope: The original range descriptor was made before upload, so its false upload/existence flags are preserved. Actual later successful uploads are documented in provenance/delivery120/PACKAGE_BLOB_UPLOAD120.json.
